title: Reminder choices
decision: A debt falling due today is reminded of even if an older debt was reminded of yesterday, the seven days applying to repeats for overdue debt; a table job_run records finished periods and its row is written after the work; the SMS quota is one platform setting applied to each shop; SMS texts are a short fixed form whatever wording the shop chose; a manual reminder is refused when reminders are off for the shop or the customer; the three wordings per language are agent drafts
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 29
rationale: The requirements name the limits and the hours but not how a new due date meets an earlier reminder, nor how a job knows a period is finished
